facts.fact: Maintainers say payload.metadata is intentionally not persisted; in the initial implementation it is meant only for consumption by processors (such as email/Slack).

The Notifications API, defined in plugins/notifications-backend/src/service/router.ts, offers read operations such as GET /api/notifications (and /notifications) and GET /api/notifications/:id (and /notifications/:id).
It also offers GET routes for status, settings and topics.
